messages:
incident-bot: P0 alert: high error-rate + latency for enterprise tenant AtlasThera in eu-central-1. Impacting dedicated pool phi and customer VPC egress. Automatic retries failing. PagerDuty incident created: PD-4721. Paging Maria / oncall.
Maria / oncall: got it, acked on PD. digging in — seeing 5xx spike from the grpc gateway to the model-hosts in phi pool.
Kevin (Infra): can you paste the metric ranges? I see connection errors from worker nodes phi-0*/phi-1* to our provider network.
Maria / oncall: short snippet from grafana: 
```
5xx-rate (atlasthera, eu-central-1) = 32% (last 5m)
p95 latency (request) = 1.8s -> 3.6s
queue depth on phi pool = 450
```
Tess (SE): AtlasThera SRE is on the bridge and reporting customer API timeouts for their end-users. They requested immediate isolation and a regional shift.
AtlasThera-SRE: confirmed — majority of user traffic hitting eu-central; can we move a portion to eu-west while you investigate? We want minimal DNS churn but will accept gradual switchover.
Maria / oncall: plan proposal: 1) isolate offending hosts (drain & cordon) in the phi pool for tenant AtlasThera; 2) spin up warm capacity in eu-west dedicated pool phi-west-warm (reserved images ready); 3) shift 25% traffic via routing policy to eu-west, then 50/50, then full cutover if healthy; 4) low-ttl DNS cutover as fallback if routing policy can't hit 100%.
Kevin (Infra): agree. I'll start the warm capacity boot sequence. Triggering dedicated pool expand API now.
deploy-bot: job 87912 queued: allocate_capacity --pool=phi-west-warm --cpu=8 --gpus=2 --env=atlasthera --expected-ready=10m
Maria / oncall: also switching model variant to atlasthera-v2-fallback on eu-central to reduce memory pressure (quantized). This is a risk for quality but reduces OOMs while we isolate.
Ashok (SRE): adding a bespoke network mitigation: apply ACL to drop traffic from problematic egress IP-ranges for phi-1* so other tenants are unaffected. Running policy patch now.
Kevin (Infra): warm pool reports images pulled; starting health checks on model server instances. ETA ~7m.
AtlasThera-SRE: thanks — when you shift traffic can you do a gradual ramp? We'll watch errors and user impact.
Maria / oncall: yes. I'll create a routing policy snippet and apply.
```
# routing policy (example)
route:
  tenant: atlasthera
  precedence:
    - region: eu-west-1, weight: 25
    - region: eu-central-1, weight: 75
  fallback_variant: atlasthera-v2-fallback
  ttl_seconds: 30
```
Maria / oncall: applying 25% weight to eu-west now.
deploy-bot: routing-change 87913 applied: tenant=atlasthera weights {eu-west:25, eu-central:75} live at 2755550120
Maria / oncall: monitoring...
Kevin (Infra): seeing decreased queue depth on phi pool and lower host memory utilisation on phi-1 nodes. 5xx-rate dropped to ~18% within 2 minutes.
AtlasThera-SRE: user-facing errors dropping. We see some SLO breaches still for long tail traffic but is manageable.
Maria / oncall: proceeding to 50/50 after 5m verification window.
deploy-bot: routing-change 87914 applied: tenant=atlasthera weights {eu-west:50, eu-central:50} live at 2755550170
Ashok (SRE): ACL patch propagated; verified other tenants unaffected.
Kevin (Infra): eu-west warm hosts passed model health checks. p99 latency on eu-west = 210ms, 5xx=0.8%.
AtlasThera-SRE: quality team ran quick sampling, fallback variant seems acceptable for the shift window.
Maria / oncall: preparing DNS fallback: lowering AtlasThera zone TTL to 30s and pre-stage eu-west CNAMEs. If routing fails to make eu-central healthy we'll cut DNS to point primary -> eu-west LB.
Maria / oncall: lowering TTL now.
deploy-bot: dns-change 87915 applied: atlasthera.example.com TTL=30s at 2755550202
Kevin (Infra): continued monitoring. Last 5m 5xx-rate = 3.1% aggregate, eu-central ~6%, eu-west ~0.6%.
Tess (SE): notifying AtlasThera PM that we're mid-shift and they should expect brief error spikes during final move.
AtlasThera-SRE: thanks. We'll keep our support desk advised. On our side we can do sticky sessions for active flows to reduce duplication.
Maria / oncall: moving to 75/25 eu-west -> eu-central to validate scale now.
deploy-bot: routing-change 87916 applied: tenant=atlasthera weights {eu-west:75, eu-central:25} live at 2755550230
Kevin (Infra): eu-central error-rate plateauing at ~4%. No new OOM kill events observed after draining phi-1*.
Maria / oncall: decision: make eu-west primary for the next 90 minutes. Will keep dedicated phi-west-warm active and start post-incident checklist.
Ashok (SRE): creating remediation ticket to replace phi-1* underlying host/network ASICs and to run deeper root-cause network trace.
Maria / oncall: impact summary to paste to PD and to AtlasThera: approx 12k requests failed (3% of 400k requests) during spike window, ~45 minutes of visible degradation for eu-central users, mitigated by ramp to eu-west.
Tess (SE): AtlasThera PM acknowledged. They requested a bridge post-mortem with timeline and suggestions for failover automation.
Maria / oncall: assigning postmortem owner: Ashok (SRE). Action items: 1) root cause network trace (Kevin), 2) dedicated pool health gating and autoscale tuning (Maria), 3) routing automation playbook for enterprise tenants (Tess), 4) customer communication draft (Tess + AtlasThera-SRE).
Ashok (SRE): ack. I'll own and schedule postmortem async doc.
AtlasThera-SRE: appreciate the fast coordination. We'll keep eu-west as primary for the next 2 hours and then test failback with your guidance.
Maria / oncall: handing off to Ashok for follow-up. I'm going offline for the next shift. Oncall handover to Ashok at 2755550255.
Ashok (SRE): taking over. If anything regresses ping me directly. I'll keep the thread updated with RCA progress and ETA for full traffic restoration. 
Maria / oncall: thanks team :thumbsup:
